items.text: Rebalanced livestock food consumption, halving the amount required.
Prevented wild livestock from dying from hunger or unmet needs, capping health loss at 50%.
Added halters to all livestock and fixed rope mechanics (adult animals now have two ropes, rope ends off‑camera).
Livestock vendor now informs you of the required wool amount when you lack enough to sell.
Fixed calf purchase dialogue that incorrectly showed a successful purchase despite insufficient scrap.
Fixed a bug where the local client player could be destroyed during a scene switch, improving reload‑map stability.
Corrected an invalid loading state on map reload, restoring camera control after reload.
Boombox activation now counts toward each team member's objective progress when they are in the same underwater lab.
Milky Healing Tea now heals 112 health (previously capped at 100).
Fixed pooling bugs that caused crabs and jellyfish to appear invisible.
Motorcycles and bicycles now dismount from the side instead of the top, fixing the previous behavior where the closest mount point (always the top) was chosen.
Wild livestock can no longer be passively tamed, preventing uncontrolled breeding sprees.
Livestock taming now decays if the bond isn't full, sleepers can't tame passively, and calves receive a small familiarity bonus without being maxed out, reducing accidental taming and breeding.
Animals that were not eating from troughs now correctly consume feed.
Cows will no longer die of hunger in properly set‑up farms, fixing a starvation bug.
Duplicate crates can no longer appear in oil rig puzzle rooms after a server crash or unclean shutdown; the puzzle generator's network cache is invalidated on reset.
Food consumption halved for all livestock, reducing upkeep.
Animals now correctly eat from troughs and cows no longer starve in well‑setup farms; wild livestock health will not drop below 50% even when hungry.
Taming system overhaul: bond decay when incomplete, sleepers cannot tame passively, calves gain a familiarity bonus without maxing, and passive taming/uncontrolled breeding of wild livestock fixed.
Halters added to every livestock animal, allowing you to lead them.
Vendor feedback improvements: calf purchase dialogue now correctly checks scrap, and livestock vendor tells you required wool amount when you lack enough to sell.
Boombox activation now counts toward the team objective when teammates are in the same underwater lab.
Motorcycles and bicycles now dismount to the side instead of on top, fixing mount point ordering.
Fixed pooling bugs that made crabs and jellyfish invisible, restoring their presence in the world.
Resolved a rare crate duplication glitch in oil‑rig puzzle rooms after server crashes.
Sheep baas and cow moo sounds now respect occlusion, providing more realistic audio.
Fixed black background on store pages when RRP is enabled and removed duplicate items from the featured tab.

items.text: Cows and sheep now show their genetics in the UI, letting you see animal traits at a glance.
Animals must be tamed before you can lead or milk them; untamed creatures no longer present those options.
Overcrowding limits raised (crowded 5, severe 9) and packing radius reduced to 2.5 m, easing herd clustering.
A client‑side trigger now pushes you off livestock and adds solid colliders, preventing you from standing on or walking through them, and leads are now sturdier and won’t break easily.
Wild cow and sheep populations have doubled, grazing time reduced, and they fill troughs twice as fast, making herd feeding easier.
Livestock vendor sales now use a normalized value currency, randomize offers, apply penalties for wild or purchased animals, and include new items such as pistol ammo and a rare red keycard.
Sandbag barricades stack up to 20 in inventory and appear in loot piles of four, greatly increasing their availability.
Pressing the inventory button now opens the crafting screen directly, speeding up item creation.
Weapon ammo counts have been doubled, giving you more shots per reload.
Extra windows in Harbor 2 have been boarded up, closing unintended sightlines into the loot room.
Jellyfish now spawn correctly in water areas.
Jungle wildlife—including crocodiles, tiger panthers, and wolves—now spawn properly after fixing a proximity check.
Fixed NullReferenceExceptions caused by out‑of‑order snapshots when players connect, preventing crashes and disconnects
Resolved InvalidOperationException in the in‑game browser when multiple refreshes occur simultaneously, stopping UI crashes
Optional objectives can now be omitted, allowing missions (e.g., underwater labs) to continue even if a goal is impossible
Lamb wool collection bug fixed, restoring correct wool yields
Creamy Pure Cooling Tea no longer raises max temperature, returning intended temperature effects
Milk skimming UI and inventory fixes: correct item notices, added skim option above drink, and fixed icon issues for new items
Selling wool now references the correct animal data, enabling proper wool sale transactions
Fluid switch visual feedback works at low object detail levels, so players can see switch state reliably

2026-09-29.summary:
### Livestock & Wildlife
- Cows and sheep now show their genetics in the UI, letting you see animal traits at a glance.
- Animals must be tamed before you can lead or milk them; untamed creatures no longer present those options.
- Overcrowding limits raised (crowded 5, severe 9) and packing radius reduced to 2.5 m, easing herd clustering.
- A client‑side trigger now pushes you off livestock and adds solid colliders, preventing you from standing on or walking through them, and leads are now sturdier and won’t break easily.
- Wild cow and sheep populations have doubled, grazing time reduced, and they fill troughs twice as fast, making herd feeding easier.
- Livestock vendor sales now use a normalized value currency, randomize offers, apply penalties for wild or purchased animals, and include new items such as pistol ammo and a rare red keycard.

### Inventory & Crafting
- Sandbag barricades stack up to 20 in inventory and appear in loot piles of four, greatly increasing their availability.
- Pressing the inventory button now opens the crafting screen directly, speeding up item creation.

### Combat & Ammo
- Weapon ammo counts have been doubled, giving you more shots per reload.

### World & Map Updates
- Extra windows in Harbor 2 have been boarded up, closing unintended sightlines into the loot room.
- Jellyfish now spawn correctly in water areas.
- Jungle wildlife—including crocodiles, tiger panthers, and wolves—now spawn properly after fixing a proximity check.

### Stability & Connectivity
- Fixed NullReferenceExceptions caused by out‑of‑order snapshots when players connect, preventing crashes and disconnects
- Resolved InvalidOperationException in the in‑game browser when multiple refreshes occur simultaneously, stopping UI crashes

### Missions & Progression
- Optional objectives can now be omitted, allowing missions (e.g., underwater labs) to continue even if a goal is impossible

### Economy & Resources
- Lamb wool collection bug fixed, restoring correct wool yields
- Creamy Pure Cooling Tea no longer raises max temperature, returning intended temperature effects
- Milk skimming UI and inventory fixes: correct item notices, added skim option above drink, and fixed icon issues for new items
- Selling wool now references the correct animal data, enabling proper wool sale transactions

### Building & Interaction
- Fluid switch visual feedback works at low object detail levels, so players can see switch state reliably

items.text: Livestock purchases now correctly credit the buying player and use a server‑side RPC, fixing desync and ensuring proper ownership.

Vendor inventory cleaned up: duplicate Custom SMG removed and replaced with a Thompson; items filtered by game mode (no guns in Primitive); turret offers only on high‑quality sales; new high‑end sale options added (BP fragments, Thompson, Custom SMG, Python, HC Revolver); wool now makes up ~75% of livestock sales, removing guns from livestock sales.
Break‑in option disabled on a teammate’s own apartment room, preventing accidental intrusions.
Fixed issue where teammates could not exit rooms after a server restart.
Livestock now match player speed when led, eliminating lead breaks and long waits.
Critter health reduced (frogs 60 HP, rabbits 100 HP) and frog size increased 20% for better balance and visibility.
Critters now flee when damaged while startled, and bull AI rotation fixed when target is lost, improving animal combat behavior.

Loot room exploits patched across maps: Radtown crate repositioned, Trainyard crate and surrounding railings sealed, Harbor 1 gaps boarded up, and all Harbor 2 windows sealed to stop cheating via shooting into loot rooms.
Null‑reference crash on destroyed elevator floors during saves fixed, improving overall stability.
Mortar desynchronization resolved for reconnecting players and those entering network range, ensuring consistent combat.
Open fence gates added to the ranch and large barn, providing easier access to the vendor area.
Water sources can now be transferred between rooms via sinks without errors.
Crabs now respect step height, avoid walls, and have corrected leg speeds; jellyfish water checks are optimized, improving swarm behavior.
Floating animal glitches are resolved, and idle animal performance is smoother.
Frogs no longer perform an excessively long first jump and will not get stuck in dead animations.
Biofuel generators are silent while idle, eliminating background noise.

2026-09-28.summary:
### Economy & Vendor
- Livestock purchases now correctly credit the buying player and use a server‑side RPC, fixing desync and ensuring proper ownership.
- Vendor inventory cleaned up: duplicate Custom SMG removed and replaced with a Thompson; items filtered by game mode (no guns in Primitive); turret offers only on high‑quality sales; new high‑end sale options added (BP fragments, Thompson, Custom SMG, Python, HC Revolver); wool now makes up ~75% of livestock sales, removing guns from livestock sales.

### Teammate Interaction
- Break‑in option disabled on a teammate’s own apartment room, preventing accidental intrusions.
- Fixed issue where teammates could not exit rooms after a server restart.

### Animal & Wildlife
- Livestock now match player speed when led, eliminating lead breaks and long waits.
- Critter health reduced (frogs 60 HP, rabbits 100 HP) and frog size increased 20% for better balance and visibility.
- Critters now flee when damaged while startled, and bull AI rotation fixed when target is lost, improving animal combat behavior.

### Map & Loot Anti‑Cheat
- Loot room exploits patched across maps: Radtown crate repositioned, Trainyard crate and surrounding railings sealed, Harbor 1 gaps boarded up, and all Harbor 2 windows sealed to stop cheating via shooting into loot rooms.

### Stability & Networking
- Null‑reference crash on destroyed elevator floors during saves fixed, improving overall stability.
- Mortar desynchronization resolved for reconnecting players and those entering network range, ensuring consistent combat.

### Map & Access
- Open fence gates added to the ranch and large barn, providing easier access to the vendor area.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Water sources can now be transferred between rooms via sinks without errors.
- Crabs now respect step height, avoid walls, and have corrected leg speeds; jellyfish water checks are optimized, improving swarm behavior.
- Floating animal glitches are resolved, and idle animal performance is smoother.
- Frogs no longer perform an excessively long first jump and will not get stuck in dead animations.

### Audio
- Biofuel generators are silent while idle, eliminating background noise.
